records.label: Physically based material response
records.visual_function: Give every surface a physically coherent response so metal, skin, fabric, glass, and plastic separate through roughness, reflectivity, and light penetration, each reading as its own material at the surface.
records.prompt: Render each material with a physically based response: distinct roughness per surface, metallic reflection only on metal, soft subsurface warmth on skin and translucent parts, and highlights whose size and sharpness follow the light source and surface smoothness.
invariants: each named material keeps one coherent roughness and reflectivity
subsurface response appears only on translucent materials
misreadings_to_avoid: uniform plastic gloss across every surface
metallic sheen on skin or cloth

records.label: Matte clay render medium
records.visual_function: Present the subject as a uniform matte clay-like 3D render that emphasizes form, silhouette, and lighting over surface texture and color detail.
records.prompt: Render the subject as a matte clay-style 3D model: one soft uniform surface with gentle ambient occlusion in crevices, rounded edge highlights, minimal texture, and lighting that reads the form through smooth value transitions.
invariants: one matte surface family covers the subject
ambient occlusion stays in contact areas and crevices
form reads through value on a smooth matte surface
misreadings_to_avoid: painted color detail breaking the clay read

records.label: Stylized appealing 3D character render
records.visual_function: Render the character as an appealing stylized 3D model with rounded simplified forms, soft edge highlights, and clean color separation, with surface detail kept at a simplified stylized level.
records.prompt: Render the subject as an appealing stylized 3D character: rounded simplified volumes, smooth clean surfacing with soft bevel highlights, large readable eyes, gentle color gradients per surface, and soft studio-style lighting that keeps every form legible.
invariants: forms stay rounded and simplified at a stylized level of anatomy
each surface keeps one clean material family
misreadings_to_avoid: photoreal pores or skin texture breaking the stylization
hard CGI plastic gloss over every surface
noisy micro-detail crowding the simplified forms

records.label: Isometric diorama render
records.visual_function: Present the scene as a crisp isometric diorama: parallel projection, miniature-set framing, and clean edge definition.
records.prompt: Render the scene as an isometric diorama in parallel projection: edges holding constant spacing across the frame, a compact staged set floating on a simple ground, crisp clean edges, vibrant flat-leaning color, and even soft lighting that keeps every plane readable.
invariants: parallel projection with receding edges staying parallel
the whole set fits inside the frame as one staged miniature
misreadings_to_avoid: perspective convergence creeping into the projection
photographic depth of field blurring the set
clutter extending past the diorama boundary

records.label: Claymation sculpted medium
records.visual_function: Render the subject as a handmade stop-motion clay sculpture with visible sculpting softness and charming seams; distinct from the smooth digital matte clay-render medium.
records.prompt: Render the subject as a handmade claymation sculpture: soft rounded clay forms with subtle fingerprint and tool softness, matte plasticine surface, slightly imperfect charming seams, centered staged composition, and warm even lighting.
invariants: surfaces read as matte moldable clay
forms stay rounded with handmade softness
imperfections stay charming and small, reading as handmade
misreadings_to_avoid: glossy plastic sheen replacing clay matte
photoreal texture overriding the sculpted look
crisp digital edges erasing the handmade feel

records.label: Layered papercraft medium
records.visual_function: Build the image from cut paper layers: stacked flat shapes, visible layer depth, and clean die-cut edges.
records.prompt: Render the subject as layered papercraft: flat cut-paper shapes stacked with visible depth between layers, clean sharp cut edges, gentle contact shadows between sheets, and a limited harmonious paper palette.
invariants: every shape reads as flat cut paper
layer order stays consistent with depth
cut edges stay clean and deliberate
misreadings_to_avoid: painterly gradients inside a single sheet
photoreal texture breaking the paper illusion
